name: Araburu Oppai-san

The rambunctious tale of a busty young girl and a flat-chested goddess. Satisfy with H play, undo the curse of the seven Breast Gods!

One day a busty young girl named Kotori visited their shrine. Kotori was burdened by her large breasts and wished for a smaller pair. Hinpaiten, unhappy with her own smallness, was taken aback. So begins the tale of a girl and a goddess, the ties that bind, and the breasts that bounce---
